name: Develop Global Ltd
summary: Operating with its various subsidiaries across Australia, Develop Global Limited specializes in the exploration and advancement of mineral resource properties. The firm's primary focus lies in uncovering deposits of base and precious metals such as copper, zinc, lead, silver, and gold. Its most significant undertaking is the Sulphur Springs project, encompassing both the Sulphur Springs and Kangaroo Caves deposits and their associated tenements, located to the southeast of Port Hedland. Established in 2006 and based in West Leederville, Australia, the company adopted its current name, Develop Global Limited, in October 2021, having previously been known as Venturex Resources Limited.
